verdict.rationale: Kick's MCP lets an agent "execute bookkeeping changes" and "update bookkeeping — all with your approval," and the gated Platform API documents operations such as workspaces.list. Neither surface documents creating or drafting journal entries, and there is no accountant-facing review queue for agent-posted entries; the approval wording refers to in-chat user approval. Journal entries are documented only as auto-generated from synced transactions, so this evidence is adjacent rather than direct support for the story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent draft and post journal entries via the API and leave them in a review queue for my accountant
